claim: A direct link to any of the five oversight pages of Potential Fraud Detection, or to an evidence room, opens that page after the demo sign-in and keeps the page in the address.
assertions: /?state=KY&view=sme&role=legislator&go=fraud&fraud=early&fstate=KY opens "Early warning · Kentucky · Psychoeducation, per 15 minutes (H2027)" after sign-in, with no role selector, and the address still names the page.

/?state=KY&view=sme&role=legislator&go=fraud&fraud=follow&fstate=KY opens "Follow the billers · where a billing group goes next" after sign-in, with no role selector, and the address still names the page.

/?state=KY&view=sme&role=legislator&go=fraud&fraud=patterns&fstate=KY opens "Provider patterns · Kentucky · Psychoeducation, per 15 minutes (H2027), 2024" after sign-in, with no role selector, and the address still names the page.

/?state=KY&view=sme&role=legislator&go=fraud&fraud=ledger&fstate=KY opens "Explanation ledger · Kentucky · Psychoeducation, per 15 minutes (H2027)" after sign-in, with no role selector, and the address still names the page.

/?state=KY&view=sme&role=legislator&go=fraud&fraud=brief&fstate=KY opens "Medicaid spending oversight brief · Kentucky · 2024" after sign-in, with no role selector, and the address still names the page.
/?state=KY&view=sme&role=oversight-auditor&go=evidence&room=mco opens "MCO Accountability" after sign-in, with no role selector, and the address still names the page.
